evidence.title: Defect detection on a packaging line
evidence.snippet:
# Defect detection on a packaging line

**Client:** a logistics company (synthetic).

## Problem
The client needed recognising things in photos and had no in-house capacity.

## What I did
I built the solution with opencv, pytorch. The work also involved something that runs the same on every machine.

## Result
The project caught 96% of defects at 30 frames per second.
